caption: The video captures a night-time cityscape viewed across a calm river, where a fireworks display unfolds over a green-lit embankment. On the left a large illuminated arena glows, while on the right a Ferris wheel with a blue-purple rim and yellow spokes turns slowly, its lights mirrored in the dark water. Thin vertical rocket trails hang within a bank of drifting smoke above the tree line for the opening portion of the clip. Near the middle a bright white-yellow burst ignites high in the center, quickly decaying into a small star pattern. From there onward two to three golden-orange starbursts bloom and expand in the upper-middle sky, their sparks spreading outward and beginning to fall. A left-side burst joins the central ones as the clusters grow. The expanding blooms and their falling sparks cast orange streaked reflections across the river surface, brightening as the sky peaks. Throughout, the building, embankment lights and streetlights remain essentially static beneath the smoke.
relations: Expanding fireworks bursts and falling sparks cast bright streaked reflections across the calm river surface.
Rocket trails within the drifting smoke bank ignite and decay into star patterns above the tree line.
Static embankment lights, arena, and Ferris wheel remain fixed while their reflections mirror continuously in the water.
